video.title: AI欧腐《美术生的复仇计划：先画他，再查他/Sketching Out Revenge:Draw Him In,Dig Up the Truth》
video.desc:
不用翻译就是快
To investigate his father's death, Milo deliberately seduces his stepbrother Ethan, a competitive swimmer. What begins as a forbidden game turns dangerously real. Together, they take on the true mastermind behind it all and unearth a long-buried case.
为了调查父亲的死因，Milo 刻意勾引自己的继兄——竞技游泳运动员 Ethan。一场本是禁忌的游戏，却渐渐变得危险而真实。最终，两人联手对抗幕后真正的主使者，揭开了一桩尘封已久的旧案。
